paragraphs.source_en: The bridge is close. I spare a look up. See Golds inside roaring at each other. Rushing to their evacsuits or escape pods. Staring at us approach like Mustang did when my horses of House Mars crashed into her and Pax in a muddy field. Our rage is something unique. Something these Luneborn don’t understand.

units.source_en: See Golds inside roaring at each other.
Rushing to their evacsuits or escape pods.
Staring at us approach like Mustang did when my horses of House Mars crashed into her and Pax in a muddy field.

ja.t: んだときのムスタングと

paragraphs.source_en: Blues scatter. Obsidians pull their weapons. Two Golds don breathmasks and unfurl razors, readying for the kill. The second before we hit, I shoot my pulseCannon. It thumps on the thick glass. Shoot again and again and again. Then I curl into a ball and smash into the thick bridge glass with the full velocity of my launch as well as a last-second burst from my thruster boots.

units.source_en: Two Golds don breathmasks and unfurl razors, readying for the kill.

ja.t: マスクをつけ、レイザーをほどいて

units.source_en: The second before we hit, I shoot my pulseCannon.
It thumps on the thick glass.
Shoot again and again and again.
Then I curl into a ball and smash into the thick bridge glass with the full velocity of my launch as well as a last-second burst from my thruster boots.

paragraphs.source_en: Out of me roars a madman’s scream.
